data_description.stay_online: Keep a client home for this many seconds after its last observation. Must be at least scan interval + request timeout. Start with 60 s; slow meshes may need more. Larger values delay departure detection.
data_description.scan_interval: Time between scheduled polls. Requests add time, so actual readings may be farther apart. Lower values increase router load; allow enough presence time for the slowest reporting node.
data_description.timeout: How long to wait for a router request. Some endpoints use shorter limits; this is not the maximum duration of a complete poll. It is separate from presence time.

network.name: Include network data
network.description: Include WAN, Wi-Fi, and topology details.

devices.name: Include connected devices
devices.description: Include list of connected devices and their information.

wifi_config.name: Include Wi-Fi configuration
wifi_config.description: Include Wi-Fi network settings (may contain sensitive data).

hide_sensitive.name: Anonymize IP/MAC addresses and names
hide_sensitive.description: Replace IP addresses, MAC addresses and names with consistent aliases within this export. Passwords, keys and known tokens are always hidden, even when this option is off.

api_diagnostics.name: Fresh API queries and responses (main + nodes)
api_diagnostics.description: Queries the known read-only diagnostic blocks on all loaded routers, including errors, skipped queries and timings. Up to 2 minutes. Passwords and session tokens are always hidden. This is a diagnostic catalogue, not every possible firmware API.

purge_inactive_devices.name: Purge inactive devices
purge_inactive_devices.description: Removes device_trackers and orphan devices after X days of inactivity.

macs.name: Limit to these MAC addresses
macs.description: Optional non-empty list of MAC addresses. With include_orphans, also clean matching client sensors left without a tracker. Inactivity and other safeguards still apply. Omit to check all clients.

days.name: Inactivity days
days.description: Number of days without activity before considering the purge.

only_randomized.name: Only randomized MACs
only_randomized.description: If enabled, only devices with randomized (private) MACs will be purged.

include_orphans.name: Include orphan devices
include_orphans.description: Also remove devices without associated entities.

include_orphans_without_age.name: Include orphans without timestamp
include_orphans_without_age.description: Allows purging even if the last activity date is unknown.

verbose.name: Detailed mode
verbose.description: Adds extended log output when executing the purge.

apply.name: Apply changes
apply.description: If disabled, runs as a dry-run (simulation) without deleting anything.
